neighbours.label: ' year' / 'annual(ly)' as the unit of a rate (income per year, $X a year)
fire: The job pays about $52,000 a year plus benefits.
Tuition at the college now costs $18,400 per year for residents.
Our family spends roughly $900 annually on car insurance.
She reported a gross income per year of just over forty thousand.
The tax would add $12 annually to the average water bill.
Maintenance on the boat runs close to $3,000 a year.
Members pay a fee of $60 per year to use the gym.
The plant produces 4 million tons annually and employs 800 people.
